C1252.title: Chinese Students Hit with $170M Bond in Target Gift Card Scam
C1252.summary: In July 2023, two Chinese students were stopped for a traffic check in Florida, where police found over 2,000 gift cards in the trunk. Investigation revealed they were part of a fraud ring targeting retailers like Target, stealing gift cards, re-encoding them with laptops and barcode scanners, and placing them back on shelves. Once activated by customers, funds were diverted to criminal accounts,
